nodes.label: Mechanics rework plan (План переделки механик)
nodes.rationale: Combat stops being a Slay the Spire clone: energy replaced by a turn timeline with parallel hero/enemy lanes; vulnerability becomes accumulating armor break; all five classes reworked at once; engine and data move to TypeScript.

nodes.label: Turn timeline (Шкала хода)
nodes.rationale: Main per-turn decision becomes "what and in which order before the enemy strikes" instead of "what energy allows".

nodes.label: Card weight = timeline cells (Вес карты)
nodes.rationale: Energy removed; card cost is its weight in cells; initial rule weight = old energy cost.

nodes.label: Tacts: 2 × 3 cells (Такты)
nodes.rationale: Start/end-of-turn triggers move to each tact (twice per turn), so their numbers are roughly halved.

nodes.label: Infinite timeline (Бесконечная шкала)
nodes.rationale: Replaces plan-then-launch turns with continuous combat; once-per-turn becomes once-per-tact; no capacity, constraint is time and draw.

nodes.label: Mechanics review 2026-11-09 (Разбор механик)
nodes.rationale: Author walked through every mechanic; this table overrides other sections.

nodes.label: Tact-by-tact stepping with stop at tact end
Enemy lanes and move weights (Дорожки врагов)
nodes.rationale: Enemy moves weigh 1–3 so an enemy acts 2–3 times per 6-cell timeline to keep pace with the hero.

nodes.label: Zero-weight cards (Карты весом 0)
nodes.rationale: Placed on a cell junction, fire immediately, count as chain links, max 2 per tact.

nodes.label: Draw: each fired card brings one new, hand max 10
Chain bonuses (Бонусы цепочки)
nodes.rationale: Introduced gradually (position and link first, then joints and length) to avoid overloading card text on small screens.

nodes.label: Up to 2 chain bonuses on rare cards (chain2)
Vulnerability as broken armor (+10%/stack, cap 10)
nodes.rationale: Stacks persist all fight and are removed only by Repair (later also by a 10+ block portion); same rules for hero and enemies.

nodes.label: Damage formula (multiplicative Strength/Weak/Vuln/class defense)
nodes.rationale: Multipliers are multiplied, not added, so Warrior defense plus vulnerability never yields negative damage.

nodes.label: Frailty removed (Хрупкость удаляется)
nodes.rationale: Replaced by Slow on the 6 enemies that applied it, to keep their character.

nodes.label: Warrior class (Воин) — armored tank, −20% hit damage
Darkness (Тьма) — only from HP payment and burned cards
Mage preparation queue (2 × weight, +50%)
nodes.rationale: Decided at stage-5 manual check: queue, empty main cells accelerate preparation; Tide no longer shortens it.

nodes.label: Brew with choice (2 random potions), choose at tact stop
Enemies, relics, potions, saves impact table
Dungeon without shops; 2–3 save rooms per act
10 acts, 12 floors each
nodes.rationale: Acts shortened from 15 to 12 floors because timeline combat takes longer.

nodes.label: Post-boss choice: stay / city / next act
Boss ice seal (ледяная печать), once per 2 tacts
Bosses with phases and timeline trick
Hero death keeps progress; revival in Temple
TypeScript migration (Vite + vite-plugin-pwa)
nodes.rationale: Types catch string typos in hundreds of cards/effects, make the timeline refactor safe, validate save format; gradual .ts/.js coexistence; other engines (Godot, Unity) would require a full rewrite and lose the installable-website model.

nodes.label: Difficulty target: ~70% act-1 clear, falling per act
Stage 5: all classes and act-1 enemies

hyperedges.label: Five classes reworked together on the timeline
Armor break system: Vulnerability, Sunder, Repair, block repair
